en.headline: Deloitte lifts Hong Kong 2026 retail sales forecast to HK$412 billion
en.dek: The firm now expects full-year growth of 8.4 per cent after a stronger-than-expected first half driven by high-value goods and visitor spending.
body: Deloitte China has raised its forecast for Hong Kong retail sales in 2026 to about HK$412 billion, representing year-on-year growth of 8.4 per cent. First-half sales reached roughly HK$203 billion, up 9.7 per cent, and the firm expects a further 7 per cent rise in the second half.

High-value categories led the rebound. Jewellery, watches and valuable gifts are projected to reach HK$60 billion (up 15.4 per cent), clothing and footwear HK$50 billion (up 16.3 per cent), and medicines and cosmetics HK$40 billion (up 11.1 per cent). Full-year visitor arrivals are expected to rise 18 per cent to 59 million, including 46 million from the mainland.

Online sales grew 27.9 per cent in the first half and are forecast to expand by more than 20 per cent for the year, pushing the online share of total retail above 10 per cent for the first time. Deloitte said the outlook is supported by stronger visitor numbers, wealth effects and product upgrade cycles.

zh.headline: 德勤上調本港今年零售銷售預測至4120億元
zh.dek: 上半年銷售約2030億元按年升9.7%，德勤料全年增長8.4%，高價值貨品及旅客消費帶動。
body: 德勤中國將2026年香港零售銷售額預測上調至約4120億元，按年增長8.4%。上半年銷售額約2030億元，按年升9.7%，該行預料下半年繼續增長7%。
高價值類別表現突出。珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物預計達600億元（升15.4%），服裝鞋履500億元（升16.3%），藥物及化妝品400億元（升11.1%）。全年訪港旅客預期增加18%至5900萬人次，當中4600萬來自內地。
上半年網上銷售按年增長27.9%，全年預計增長超過兩成，網購滲透率首次突破零售總額一成。德勤指，訪港旅客強勁增長、財富效應及科技產品升級換代支持零售表現。
